Full summary: Wave B implemented (TDD, unreleased): twining_amend across all storage layers + graph + tool, and self-post marking in assemble. 1592 tests green, build clean. Adversarial review workflow in flight; release follows its findings.
Decisions: Chose add-only union semantics for twining_amend over replace — replace could silently delete an author's declared assertion; removal is a rarer, different need deliberately left unbuilt (decision-not-taken recorded); idempotent re-amends append no provenance and touch no store; Chose a dedicated IDecisionStore.amendMetadata over widening updateStatus — the file backend's updateStatus syncs only status to the index while getByScope reads affected_files FROM the index, so reusing it would produce the exact half-repair invariant 1 warned about; the interface addition also makes tsc force the ExportingDecisionStore delegation (invariant 2 self-enforces); Chose GraphAutoPopulator.onAmend receiving ONLY newly-added paths over re-running onDecide — relations are append-only and never deduplicated in either backend, so full-list re-population would duplicate every existing decided_by edge; the concept upsert guarantees the relation target exists for pre-graph decisions; Chose full-surface registration for twining_amend, matching twining_link_commit's metadata-mutation class — repair/curation is not an everyday default-surface verb; the field store runs full_surface true; Chose process-start-time for self-post detection with mark-don't-score rendering — agent_id is a role label (61% main), no session_id exists; entries newer than construction are the caller's by the one-process-per-session property; skipped a BEHAVIORS.md section for amend since the tool description is self-contained (decision-not-taken)
Findings: Graph relations store entity ULIDs, not names — a test asserting relation.target === decisionId silently matches nothing; resolve through the entity list (cost one investigation cycle in this session's graph-edge test); The record-sync mirror pin for amendMetadata went green immediately because the ExportingDecisionStore delegation was implemented before that test was written — sequence inverted vs strict TDD for that one pin; the interface-forced delegation plus the passing pin still guard the invariant
summary: Wave B implemented (TDD, unreleased): twining_amend across all storage layers + graph + tool, and self-post marking in assemble. 1592 tests green, build clean. Adversarial review workflow in flight…
